description: SNAMUTS - Route Segments is a series of datasets listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Spatial Network Analysis For Multi-Modal Urban Transport Systems. This dataset presents the Spatial Network Analysis for Multimodal Urban Transport Systems (SNAMUTS) route segments for the year of 2021. Route segments are a public transport link between two adjacent activity nodes or other network nodes. Coverage: Australia. The portal lists 3 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Spatial Network Analysis For Multi-Modal Urban Transport Systems. Its tags are indicator, transport. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2025-07-31 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
